q: bu yıl en çok satan 10 kitap
sql:
SELECT TOP 10
    it."CODE" AS stok_kodu,
    it."NAME" AS kitap,
    SUM(sl."AMOUNT") AS adet,
    SUM(sl."TOTAL") AS tutar
FROM dbo_LG_411_01_STLINE sl
JOIN dbo_LG_411_ITEMS it ON it."LOGICALREF" = sl."STOCKREF"
WHERE sl."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND sl."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND sl."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND sl."DATE_" >= '2026-01-01'
  AND sl."DATE_" < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY it."CODE", it."NAME"
ORDER BY adet DESC

FROM [dbo].[LG_411_01_INVOICE] AS INVOICE
JOIN [dbo].[LG_411_CLCARD] AS CLCARD ON INVOICE.[CLIENTREF] = CLCARD.[LOGICALREF]
WHERE INVOICE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (2, 3, 7, 8, 9)
  AND INVOICE.[DATE_] >= '2026-01-01' AND INVOICE.[DATE_] < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY CLCARD.[SPECODE2]
ORDER BY net_ciro DESC

  AND I.[TRCODE] IN (2, 3, 7, 8, 9)
  AND I.[DATE_] >= '2026-01-01' AND I.[DATE_] < '2027-01-01'
